_comment: TOOL is source code and schema. Real run DATA belongs in the versioned PRIVATE companion. Public source physically contains no real DATA.
_audited: 2026-08-30 FIRST AUDIT. The real-run output here is a person's entire QQ chat history: pulled mobile dbs, desktop Msg3.0.db copies, decoded JSON, and .bak exports. Every landing path is declared and sealed so a real run cannot deposit history at a repo-relative path even with git add -f. The Frida monitor logs are also real-run output and are sealed.
_data_home: <companion>/data/ of the versioned PRIVATE qq-history-recovery-config companion beside this repository (override with $QQ_HISTORY_RECOVERY_CONFIG or $QQ_HISTORY_RECOVERY_DATA_DIR). No home-directory default and no public source fallback.
